title: domain.days_between
description: Whole local days between two instants in a zone (DST-aware); one day fewer for a subscription terminated by upgrade. Rule: (1) if `to` falls exactly on a local midnight of `timezone`, move it one second later (a period that ends at midnight counts the day that starts there); (2) take the local wall-clock duration from `from` to `to`, i.e. the elapsed time corrected by the change of UTC offset between the two instants, so a DST change neither adds nor removes a day; (3) divide by 24 hours and round up to an integer (any fraction of a day counts as a whole day); (4) with `terminated_upgraded: true`, subtract 1 and floor at 0.

to.description: End instant of the period (see rule step 1 for an end exactly at local midnight).

timezone.description: IANA zone whose local midnights and UTC offsets are used (the effective time zone of the customer).

terminated_upgraded.description: The period belongs to a subscription that was terminated by an upgrade to another plan.
